messages:
Linh T.: FYI -- rolled a change to VPC Flow Logs in eu-west1 earlier this morning (full flow logging -> 1min granularity, retention 7d) to help debug cross-az connection drops. Seeing unexpected side effects: GPU node provisioning queues are sticky and keystore calls time out more often.
Saurabh: wait, full flow logs -> much more egress to our logging backend, right? Did we also flip sampling?
Linh T.: I didn't touch sampling, just enabled full fields. The NAT gw egress metrics spiked right after.
Megan P.: saw the same. NAT conntrack and NAT gw throughput hit flatline for ~10m this morning. KMS decrypts started failing with 504s while nodes try to join.
Alex R.: timeline from deploy bot: deployer@ci applied flowlog-mode=full at 09:12 UTC. Cloudwatch shows natgw_e2e_bytes 3x baseline and conntrack_alloc approaching limits at 09:14.
ops-bot: [system] Alert: eu-west1-nat-gw connection saturation (CPU 92%, conntrack 98%) triggered at 09:15 UTC.
Saurabh: that's likely the path: increased flow log egress -> NAT saturated -> KMS calls (via private keystore) timeout -> kube-provisioner retries -> provisioning backlog -> GPU warm pool drain.
Megan P.: quick mitigation: can we switch flow logs back to sampled or route flow logs to internal S3 via privatelink to bypass NAT?
Linh T.: I can flip sampling to 10% now. That should reduce egress by ~8-10x. Will that break the debug story?
Alex R.: short-term yes flip to sampling. Long term we need a privatelink to our logging bucket or a VPC endpoint for the ingest to avoid NAT. Also scale NAT gw or add another for failover.
Saurabh: cost note: full flow logs were adding ~1.2TB/day egress to logging -> rough cost +$1.8k/day in eu-west1 until sampling. We should include that in the rollback rationale.
Megan P.: rollback plan: 1) set flowlog sampling=0.1, 2) drain and scale up NAT gw (if not auto), 3) monitor keystore success rate, 4) plan privatelink route.
Linh T.: doing step 1 now: `gcloud compute networks vpc-flow-logs update --log-sampling 0.1 --region eu-west1`
ops-bot: [system] change applied by Linh T. at 09:22 UTC: flowlog sampling set to 0.1 for eu-west1.
Alex R.: after sampling flip, conntrack usage dropped ~65% in 5m and keystore success rate went from 73% -> 98% in our dashboards. GPU warmers are catching up.
Megan P.: great. We'll still need an action item for privatelink and NAT autoscale. Can security confirm any compliance issues with changing retention/sampling window? @SecurityBot
SecurityBot: sampling change is fine for short-term diagnostics; ensure we record the change and retention in the audit log. For privatelink we'll need a design doc + SSO access list for the logging bucket.
Saurabh: created a followup ticket: INFRA-3421 - flowlogs->privatelink + nat autoscale + audit retention. Assigning to Linh and Alex.
Linh T.: thanks. I'll add the cost numbers and timeline to the ticket. Will watch for any regressions and keep this channel updated. :thumbsup:
Megan P.: marking incident as mitigated for provisioning lag; still monitoring for 1h window.
Alex R.: one more perf note: consider reducing flowlog field granularity (drop L4 payload) when not troubleshooting to save bytes.
Linh T.: noted.
ops-bot: [system] thread closed by Linh T. (temporary fix applied) at 09:30 UTC.
